# SHIP

> The Chief of Staff for engineering leadership. SHIP starts from your company
> goals and reads the work your teams already produce — code, tickets, docs, chat
> — then briefs you, answers any question in chat or your IDE, preps your 1:1s,
> and catches drift early.

SHIP is top-down engineering intelligence: goals first, tasks second. It reads
the artefact trail teams already produce and classifies it against leadership
intent, surfacing alignment and drift instead of activity vanity metrics.
Operated by SHIP Platform Inc. (Delaware, US). Currently in private pilot.

## Product

- [Capabilities](https://shipplatform.ai/#capabilities): Brief (decision-ready morning narrative), Ask (conversational answers over your org, in app/Slack/Claude/Cursor), Prep (1:1 preparation), Catch drift (early signal when execution diverges from funded initiatives).
- [How it works](https://shipplatform.ai/#how-it-works): Encode goals → Connect tools via read-only OAuth → Brief.
- [Integrations](https://shipplatform.ai/#integrations): GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Confluence, Slack, Linear, Notion, Gmail. Coming soon: Google Meet, Google Drive, Zoom.
- [Pricing](https://shipplatform.ai/#pricing): Startup (by application) and Enterprise (custom). Design partners get founding-partner pricing.
